export const execSchema = z.object({ code: z.string().min(1).max(30000), sessionId: idSchema.optional(), changeSessionId: idSchema.optional(), requestId: idSchema, expectedVersion: z.number().int().nonnegative().optional() }).strict();

'nodes.setSourceMappings': { schema: z.object(sourceMappingsFields).strict(), description: 'Replace the complete source mappings and evidence without changing ASCII, content anchors, or layout. Requires the current content.asciiSha256 as expectedContentHash. Omitted source preserves the repository binding; empty mappings/evidence clears mappings. Undoable and persisted in workspace history; proposal calls stay isolated.', example: 'return nodes.setSourceMappings({nodeId:"grid:overview",expectedContentHash:node.content.asciiSha256,mappings,evidence});' },

'nodes.patchDiagram': { schema: z.object({ nodeId: idSchema, start: z.number().int().positive(), end: z.number().int().positive(), patch: z.string().max(20000) }).strict(), description: 'Replace 1-based inclusive raw ASCII lines. Empty patch deletes lines; trailing newline inserts a blank line. Ranges address the current document (later calls see earlier committed edits). Untouched mappings and source jumps shift; intersecting mappings are removed and changed anchors remain stale. Shared content updates all its instances. Undoable; no save.', example: 'return nodes.patchDiagram({nodeId:"grid:overview",start:2,end:3,patch:"|-- Updated"});' },

'nodes.setJumps': { schema: z.object({ nodeId: idSchema, jumps: z.array(diagramJumpSchema).max(2000) }).strict(), description: 'Replace diagram-local jumps without changing ASCII. Source ranges are original 1-based inclusive columns on the current content revision/hash; contentNodeId is optional. Target representationId is a saved catalog canvas ID, not a live canvasId. Empty list removes all jumps. Undoable; explicit save required.', example: 'return nodes.setJumps({nodeId:"grid:overview",jumps:[]});' },

'edges.list': { schema: z.object({}).strict(), description: 'Read saved diagram connections. Endpoint displayNodeId identifies a GridBox instance; contentNodeId and revisionId come from nodes.get contentNodes and content.', example: 'return edges.list();' },

'edges.create': { schema: diagramConnectionSchema.omit({ id: true }), description: 'Connect a content node to another content node or GridBox. appearance.label accepts {text, position?:{x,y}}; position is the label horizontal center and text baseline in absolute unscaled canvas pixels. Omit position for automatic placement. Legacy string labels remain supported. Does not change diagram content.', example: 'return edges.create({source, target, appearance:{color:"#7dd3fc",lineStyle:"solid",label:{text:"Uses",position:{x:400,y:180}}}});' },

'edges.update': { schema: diagramConnectionSchema, description: 'Replace a connection by ID, including endpoints or appearance. appearance.label accepts {text, position?:{x,y}} in absolute unscaled canvas pixels (horizontal center, text baseline); omit position to restore automatic placement. Unchanged stale endpoints may be retained.', example: 'return edges.update({...edge, appearance:{...edge.appearance,label:{text:"Uses",position:{x:400,y:180}}}});' },
'edges.remove': { schema: z.object({ edgeId: idSchema }).strict(), description: 'Remove one connection without deleting either diagram.', example: 'return edges.remove({edgeId:"…"});' },
'canvas.list': { schema: z.object({}).strict(), description: 'List registered live Mapping pages and their documents.', example: 'return canvas.list();' },

'canvas.attach': { schema: z.object({ canvasId: idSchema, documentId: idSchema }).strict(), description: 'Bind a new session to a live document. Use returned sessionId on subsequent calls.', example: 'return canvas.attach({canvasId:"…",documentId:"…"});' },

'canvas.createDocument': { schema: z.object({ canvasId: idSchema, name: z.string().trim().min(1).max(120) }).strict(), description: 'Create an unsaved document and attach a session. Does not create a confirmed representation.', example: 'return canvas.createDocument({canvasId:"…",name:"Proposed design"});' },

'canvas.copyDocument': { schema: z.object({ canvasId: idSchema, documentId: idSchema, name: z.string().trim().min(1).max(120), expectedVersion: z.number().int().nonnegative().optional() }).strict(), description: 'Copy a live document, including unsaved edits, diagrams, mappings, edges, layout and pane presentation, into an independent unsaved draft with a fresh undo baseline. Returns its attachment. Optional expectedVersion checks the source. Use an unbound exec without sessionId or changeSessionId. Does not publish or modify the source; transient controls and pending requests are reset.', example: 'return canvas.copyDocument({canvasId:"…",documentId:"…",name:"Canvas copy",expectedVersion:0});' },
'nodes.list': { schema: z.object({}).strict(), description: 'Read the DisplayNode registry including GridBoxes and FloatingBoxes.', example: 'return nodes.list();' },
'nodes.get': { schema: z.object({ nodeId: idSchema }).strict(), description: 'Read a complete DisplayNode and its diagram content.', example: 'return nodes.get({nodeId:"grid:overview"});' },

'nodes.draw': { schema: z.object({ ...contentFields, parentId: idSchema.optional(), position: point.optional() }).strict(), description: 'Create a diagram; natural content size feeds push-right grid layout. Position is parent-relative cells.', example: 'return nodes.draw({ascii:"[Service]",position:{column:0,row:0}});' },

'nodes.replace': { schema: z.object({ nodeId: idSchema, ...contentFields }).strict(), description: 'Replace diagram content and rerun layout.', example: 'return nodes.replace({nodeId:"grid:overview",ascii:"[Updated]"});' },

'nodes.move': { schema: z.object({ nodeId: idSchema, position: z.union([point, z.object({ x: z.number().finite(), y: z.number().finite() }).strict()]) }).strict(), description: 'Move GridBoxes in absolute canvas cells; FloatingBoxes in pixels in their declared coordinate space.', example: 'return nodes.move({nodeId:"grid:overview",position:{column:20,row:4}});' },

'nodes.collapse': { schema: z.object({ nodeId: idSchema, contentNodeId: idSchema.optional(), collapsed: z.boolean() }).strict(), description: 'Collapse/expand a DisplayNode, or a content subtree using contentNodeId from node.collapsible.subtrees.', example: 'return nodes.collapse({nodeId:"grid:overview",collapsed:true});' },

'nodes.remove': { schema: z.object({ nodeId: idSchema }).strict(), description: 'Remove an object. The root and last visible diagram are protected.', example: 'return nodes.remove({nodeId:"floating:…"});' }

export const diagramEditRunSchema = z.object({ runId: id }).strict();
export function createMappingRoutes({ selection, diagrams, workspace, chat, compactionService, agent, liveCanvas }: {
selection: SelectionService; diagrams: MappingDiagramService; workspace: MappingWorkspaceService;
return async (request: Connect.IncomingMessage, response: ServerResponse, url: URL): Promise<void> => {
if (selectionRead && liveCanvas) return readLiveSelection(request, response, decodeURIComponent(selectionRead[1]), liveCanvas);
if (url.pathname.startsWith('/api/mapping/agent/') && agent) return handleAgentRoutes(request, response, url, agent);
if (request.method === 'POST') return sendJson(response, 200, await workspace.applyBatch(await readBody(request, 64 * 1024 * 1024) as WorkspaceBatch));
if (request.method !== 'PUT') return sendJson(response, 405, { error: 'method not allowed' });
// Workspace saves include revision histories and captured source evidence.
if (request.method !== 'POST') return sendJson(response, 405, { error: 'method not allowed' });
return sendJson(response, 200, await diagrams.save(await readBody(request) as SaveProjectDiagramInput));
if (request.method !== 'DELETE') return sendJson(response, 405, { error: 'method not allowed' });
if (request.method !== 'POST') return sendJson(response, 405, { error: 'method not allowed' });
const input = await selection.prepare(await readBody(request) as Record<string, unknown>);
const result = await selection.run(input, event => sendEvent(response, { type: 'progress', ...event }));
return sendJson(response, 404, { error: 'API route not found' });
